score_contract.score_semantics: basewise evolutionary conservation/acceleration score; positive values indicate conservation and negative values indicate faster evolution

provenance.notes: Official UCSC GRCh38 100-vertebrate track and WIG download path were audited. PhyloP is a site-wise conservation/acceleration annotation, not an alternate-minus-reference sequence score, so it cannot be an apples-to-apples raw variant-effect model without a predeclared comparator transform. The existing deterministic comparator remains test-only.
